InCad for FreeCAD - what changed
================================

This build: VERSION
Newest build first. The build name is the name of the zip file.


0.1.2
-----
Improvements
- Sketch: new Constraint List (ribbon Sketch > Constrain > List, or right-click in a sketch >
  Constraint List). It lists the sketch's constraints, including the ones with no icon to click
  (coincident points, point on a line). Pick a line or point to see only its own; select a row to
  see it in the sketch; check rows and press Delete selected (one undo step). Constraints that hold
  a sketch pattern, and dimensions used in a formula, are kept, and the window says why.
- Sketch: right-click a line or point to delete one of its constraints, or all of them.
- Hole: new Chamfer option for every hole (None / Start / Both ends, with a size): a 45° lead-in at the
  mouth of each hole of the Hole and, for a through hole, at its exit. A tapped hole is chamfered from
  the thread's diameter, so a screw starts easily. With a seat (counterbore, countersink, spotface)
  only the exit can be chamfered.

Bug fixes
- Threads (Threads Off, Suppress) did nothing on a part with two threads when the second one was
  made after the first: it hung on the first thread. Threads now attach to the hole itself, and
  older files are repaired the first time threads are turned off.
- Threads Off / On left the modeled thread of a tapped Hole on (the button looked dead after making
  one). It now turns those threads off too; the holes themselves stay.
- Wireframe was nearly invisible in the dark theme. Its lines are now light (dark in the light theme)
  and thicker; Shaded puts the normal lines back.
- Thread on a rod came out sloppy: with the print clearance a hair-thin fin (about 0.04 mm) stayed on
  every crest, worse when the rod was a little larger than the size (M2.5 on Ø2.594). The rod is now
  turned down to the thread's crests first (a ThreadTrim step under the Thread), so the crests are clean.
- Parameters lost their units in a file opened again (an angle showed 90 instead of 90°, a length 12
  instead of 12 mm) in the Parameters list and in the dialogs. They keep them now.


0.1.1
-----
Improvements
- Thread: any sensible size works in a hole. A Ø3 hole takes M3 (the hole is filled back to the
  M3 tap size first) or M4 (the hole is bored out to the M4 tap size first), always as a full,
  printable thread with the print clearance. The fill goes only where the hole has a wall all round,
  never into a crossing bore. A size far off the hole is still refused.
- Thread: Size "Auto" now picks the bolt that matches the hole (Ø3 -> M3, Ø4 -> M4); a tap-drill
  hole still gets its thread (Ø5.2 -> M6, Ø8.5 -> M10).
- New ribbon button "Threads" (3D Model > Modify): turns every thread off for faster work and
  redraws, and back on with a second click. A thread you turned off yourself stays off.
- Suppress / Unsuppress on a thread also turns off its chamfer and its fill or bore-out, so the
  part looks exactly as it did before the thread.

Bug fixes
- Thread on a through hole (or a rod free at both ends) started at the plain end, so the chamfered
  mouth had no thread when the thread was shorter than the hole. It now starts at the chamfered or
  rounded end.
- Thread: picking the front face as the Start face of a hole with a chamfered mouth said "The start
  face must be at one end of the threaded face". It is accepted now.
- Suppress / Unsuppress on a thread could fail with "ThreadProfile cannot be suppressed".


0.1.0
-----
First test build.
